title: Deep learning detects paroxysmal atrial fibrillation from sinus-rhythm Holter ECG in a prospective trial
summary: Convolutional models were trained on 20,000 30-s sinus-rhythm Holter blocks (cross-validation sensitivity 84.2%, specificity 66.2%) and a separate set of 54 patients tuned the threshold (84.9% and 69.9%). In a prospective multicentre trial of 24 patients with AF within 7 days and 20 controls, sensitivity was 91.7% (95% CI 73.0-99.0) and specificity 65.0% (40.8-84.6). The trial is small (n=44) with modest specificity; abstract only.
ai_technology: Convolutional deep-learning classifier of 30-s sinus-rhythm ECG blocks

evidence.tested: Prospective multicentre trial (UMIN000047182) with 7-day patch monitoring as outcome reference.
evidence.unknown: Specificity in larger groups; full text was not reviewed; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional network flagged patients with paroxysmal AF from sinus-rhythm ECG.
